right_defects.source: memoria cartarum ... revocatus a latentibus custodiis mense Majo interceptus
right_defects.translation: because of the papers ... he was recalled by hidden guards and intercepted
who was spreading dangerous principles of faith in the year 1700

why: RIGHT makes the hidden guards the ones who recalled Quesnel and moves the date; LEFT renders the post-break sentence correctly.
Both cross the break well, but LEFT misreads portus as power and drops eternal after the break.

left_defects.source: in futurum spectat multa, que iure sibi possit ... promittere
left_defects.translation: looks to the future, for which it can rightly promise itself

why: The sentence crossing the break (Vra / autem etas ... multa) loses multa in LEFT and is complete in RIGHT, though RIGHT places the whole next page before the break marker.

left_defects.translation: mysteries of the Faith / God, in which

why: LEFT renders the split word Fi-dei twice, as Faith and again as God; RIGHT joins it correctly.
Both render the sentences on each side of the break (sine angustia te parturiuit / Benedicta sis) faithfully.
The break falls between psalms and both render the adjoining verses fully; the differences (sola luna, impinguat) fall outside the junction region.
Clean break between litany and prayer; both render Sed libera / Ego dixi domina faithfully.
Both join the crossing sentence (ouibus ... a / nobis pastoribus); LEFT drops accurate just after, while RIGHT inserts the marginal refs Act. 17 / Ioan. 5 mid-sentence, which hurts only flow.

left_defects.source: qui, cum nihil / hil impetrare posset
left_defects.translation: since he could obtain nothing... / he could obtain nothing

why: LEFT renders the split clause twice across the break; RIGHT renders it once.

left_defects.translation: in the flesh, crucified, manifested in the flesh

why: Right after the break LEFT repeats in the flesh and drops magis while RIGHT renders it literally; each has one mistranslation before the break.

left_defects.source: qui, cum nihil / hil impetrare posset
left_defects.translation: since he could obtain nothing... / he could obtain nothing

why: LEFT duplicates the clause split across the break; RIGHT carries it over once (since nothing / could be obtained).

right_defects.source: tu nobis preces suggerens ipse audire propitius et exaudire digneris
right_defects.translation: hear propitiously those who suggest prayers to us

why: In the first sentences after the break RIGHT drops clementiam tuam and inverts who suggests the prayers.
Both render the hyphenated Damna-/mnatur once and faithfully; LEFT keeps the hyphen split (con- / demned), which reads less continuously.
Both carry locus / propitiationis across the break faithfully.

left_defects.source: und durch andere Leute darzu angetrieben / damit fortzufahren
left_defects.translation: and He urged others to proceed with it

why: Both join Augspur-/gischen Confession correctly, but shortly before the break LEFT turns J.B. being urged by others into God urging others.
Clean sentence break; both render consummatio / Sit queso faithfully, and their other differences fall outside the junction.
